We're still short on qualified candidates for the marketing coordinator position. I've reviewed the current applicant pool and only two meet the basic requirements. Should we extend the posting deadline or reach out directly to some referrals?

I've completed the initial review of next month's travel requests. We have 14 pending approvals, with 6 requiring international visas that need immediate attention. I'll prioritize the visa applications and send a detailed breakdown by end of day. Let me know if any trips are business-critical and need expedited processing.

Checking in on the break room coffee machine repair—it's been out since Monday and I'm getting complaints. Should I call the service tech directly or do we need approval from admin first? Also, the west wing hallway lights are flickering again; I'll do a walkthrough tonight to check if it's the same ballast issue as last month.

Starting our search for the new marketing coordinator position. I've drafted the job description and will post it to LinkedIn and Indeed by end of day. Let me know if anyone wants to review before it goes live.

Reviewing the vendor contract from Acme Logistics that's due Friday. Their liability cap language looks weaker than our standard template—need to flag this before we send redlines. Can anyone confirm if procurement already negotiated service levels with them, or should I open that discussion fresh?

Checking the west wing conference rooms today—Room 302 has a flickering overhead light and the projector in 305 keeps overheating after twenty minutes. I'll put in a maintenance ticket for both and update the room availability calendar so no one books them until repairs are done. Let me know if there are other spaces I should prioritize this week.
